g.text: READY candidates need selection · thesis STOPPED · semantic dashboard owns the detailed view

a.xlink:title: Project completion requires supported and readable selected thesis claims, truthful code/data/reproduction and availability promises, a frozen candidate meeting the recorded human PASS threshold, required delivery/archive dispositions, and released assignments. This map does not assert any present whole-project readiness. blocker: Workflow implementation/acceptance, thesis source/support/human PASS, code/evidence and reproduction checks, actual delivery/archive dispositions and final session release remain unfinished. plan_gap: Source-backed completion model needs Jörn’s selection of bounded execution windows. Current administrative status is unknown; the scientific synthesis remains a dated unreconciled 25 September snapshot. project: msc-math authorization: Outcome map selected; thesis execution and external delivery are not authorized. next_step: Use the project branches to select useful bounded work in separate worktrees; do not restart the stopped thesis run automatically. Sources: docs/coordination/thesis-work.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md, docs/project-facts.md, ARCHITECTURE.md

Explicitly authorized conditional attempt scheduled and active for 4 October 2026 04:00 Berlin (02:00 UTC), targeting only the reset expiring at 04:36. Fresh read-only check passed at 21:34:18 UTC (four available resets, weekly usage 3%). Installed reviewed script/config in private host state; validated units and next-elapse. Service has not started and no real redemption request has been sent. Server acceptance remains unknown and user accepted possible failure. Actual systemd execution environment was additionally checked in read-only mode at 21:53:55 UTC; service exited successfully without consumption. Final reliability update: at most three transport attempts with identical credit/key, atomic result checkpoints before/after the consumption response, and a 300-second service timeout. Ten mock checks pass, including ambiguous-response retry and preservation of confirmed success if refresh fails. Installed code passed a fresh read-only systemd launch. Timer remains active for 04:00 Berlin; real redemption is pending. Claude Code fallback timer codex-reset-0400-claude.timer is installed and active for the same 4 October 04:00 Berlin trigger. It waits for the primary (up to 305 seconds), skips confirmed success or semantic refusal, and otherwise launches one bounded 120-second Claude session restricted to the existing pinned script command. A fresh process reuses exactly the primary credit/idempotency key. Six guard/command checks and an actual-systemd read-only launcher check passed. Claude auth status remains loggedIn=false: the fallback currently has an authentication blocker and is expected to fail at startup unless a valid login is available at execution. No login, model call or redemption was made during setup. Normal Claude subscription login (claude auth login --claudeai) has now been started; it is waiting for user sign-in/code completion. No successful authentication or model call has been established. The browser inspection call did not return and was terminated. The primary reset timer is independent of this pending login. Claude subscription login completed successfully after the user supplied the normal one-time authorization code. An actual-systemd read-only fallback check now reports claude_logged_in=true and exit 0. This resolves the earlier login blocker; both timers are still active for 4 October 04:00 Berlin. No Claude model call or reset consumption was made during authentication verification. owner: host systemd user timers codex-reset-0400.timer and codex-reset-0400-claude.timer project: workflows authorization: User authorized the conditional 04:00 attempt and requested considering a scheduled Claude Code session as an additional route. Primary and bounded Claude fallback use one logical pinned earned-reset redemption with the identical credit/key. Claude fallback may launch one session for at most 120 seconds after local failure; only the exact existing script command is allowed. No other credit, purchase, login, semantic-refusal retry, repository edits or other agents/model turns are authorized for this job. next_step: Both timers trigger at 04:00 Berlin. Primary writes private result.json; the now-authenticated Claude fallback skips success or server refusal and otherwise attempts the same pinned command after local failure, recording claude-result.json. Host must be awake/online. Actual server acceptance is established only by the primary command response. Sources: docs/coordination/README.md

No substantial autonomous programme or paid spending approved. next_step: Retain for later human review; Jörn says the PDF-reading window is exhausted. Do not request reading now or infer acceptance. Independent check confirmed placements, constants and template completeness. Capacity formula extends to every symmetric heptagon partner, with sharp oriented fourteen-gon equality shape. Agent-derived; human acceptance, novelty and thesis inclusion unselected. project: research authorization: Small preliminary discrimination of the pending programme, not approval of substantial four-agent execution. next_step: Use this exact result to assess further method development; do not count the solved heptagon case as work needing a multi-hour run. Nonobtuse templates fit the incircle; obtuse templates use one extreme antipodal placement or a smaller disk. Independent assembled review found no material error. Exact capacity, sharp equality shape and decreasing constants retained. Generalization is not human-accepted, novelty-certified or selected for thesis inclusion. project: research authorization: Bounded preliminary comparison of method scope; no substantial four-agent execution package launched. next_step: Compare attribution and reader-facing method value with selected pentagon presentation; no enumeration is required for this theorem. Independent review checked exact antipodal endpoint identity and finite strict margins. One rational nonregular pentagon calibration certificate gives all ten template covers, capacity=1 for reference product and exact areas/ratio. Independent arithmetic/geometry audit passed. No production solver run, quantified neighborhood, thesis selection or human acceptance. project: research authorization: Small bounded preliminary method/value discrimination and one control certificate; no substantial portfolio execution or paid spending. next_step: Use exact control and unified theorem in further value/reader-route comparison; implementation comparison must account for actual binary64 input and remains unexecuted.
